description: This is a deprecated endpoint. Please use /submittals/{id} endpoint.

id.description: Unique identifier of the Submittal Log. Use as the `{id}` path parameter to retrieve this Submittal Log.

number.description: User-facing Submittal Log number (may be alphanumeric).

formatted_number.description: Deprecated. Combined specification-section and number label. No longer returned by this endpoint; use `number` instead.

revision.description: Revision label of the Submittal Log.

private.description: True when the Submittal Log is marked private.

received_date.description: Date the submittal was received, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format.

issue_date.description: Date the submittal was issued, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format.

submit_by.description: Date the submittal must be submitted by, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format.

due_date.description: Date the response is due, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format.

type.description: Submittal type label (for example, Product Information).

description.description: Plain-text description of the Submittal Log (HTML markup removed).

status.description: Current status label of the Submittal Log.

closed.description: True when the Submittal Log is in a closed status.

created_by.description: User who created the Submittal Log.

received_from.description: User the submittal was received from. Omitted when no sender is recorded.

approvers.description: Approvers assigned to the Submittal Log, including their response and any returned attachments.

id.description: Unique identifier of the approver record.

sent_date.description: Date the submittal was sent to the approver, in ISO 8601 format.

email_sent_at.description: The datetime when the notification email was dispatched to the approver, expressed in the project's timezone. Null for historical records or when no email was sent. Note sent_date may be present wh...

returned_date.description: Date the approver returned the submittal, in ISO 8601 format.

due_date.description: Date the approver's response is due, in ISO 8601 format.

days_to_respond.description: Number of days allotted for the approver to respond.

comment.description: Comment left by the approver with their response.

distributed.description: IDs of users the approver's response was distributed to.

attachments.description: Files returned by the approver with their response.

distribution_members.description: Users on the Submittal Log's distribution list.

ball_in_court.description: Users currently responsible for acting on the Submittal Log (the "ball in court").

location.description: Physical location associated with the Submittal Log.

name.description: Full location name, including parent locations.

node_name.description: Name of this location node, without parent locations.

parent_id.description: ID of the parent location, if any.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to Location

specification_section.description: Specification section the Submittal Log belongs to. Omitted when the log is not associated with a section.

id.description: Unique identifier of the specification section.

current_revision_id.description: Identifier of the specification section's current revision, if versioned.

attachments.description: Files attached directly to the Submittal Log.

distribution_info.description: Details of the most recent distribution of the Submittal Log. Omitted when the log has not been distributed.

id.description: Unique identifier of the distribution record.

distributed_date.description: Timestamp when the submittal was distributed, in ISO 8601 format.

distributed_to.description: Users the submittal was distributed to.

final_attachments.description: Final attachments included with the distribution.

submittal_package.description: Submittal Package the log belongs to. Omitted when the log is not part of a package.

id.description: Unique identifier of the Submittal Package.

created_by.description: User who created the Submittal Package.

description.description: Plain-text description of the Submittal Package (HTML markup removed).

attachments.description: Files attached to the Submittal Package.

403.description: User does not have right permissions.
